items.prompt: What is the root word of helpful?

options.why: -ful is the suffix, not the root word.
Helper is in the same family, but it is not the root word.
Helpless is in the same family, but it is longer than the root.

hints: The root word is the main part of the word.
Take away the suffix at the end.
What is left when you take off -ful?
items.explanation: The root word is help. The suffix -ful is added to make helpful.

items.prompt: Which word is in the same word family as play?

options.why: Plate starts with pla, but it has nothing to do with playing.
Plan is not about playing.
Place is not about playing.

hints: Words in a family share a root word and a meaning.
Look for a word that has the whole word play in it.
Does the word have something to do with playing?
items.explanation: Player has the root word play in it, and it means someone who plays.

items.prompt: Choose all the words in the friend word family.

options.why: Fried is about cooking, not friends.
Fright means a sudden fear.

hints: A word family shares the same root word.
Look for the whole word friend inside each word.
Check the meaning too. Is it about being a friend?
items.explanation: Friendly, friendship and unfriendly all contain the root word friend, and they are all about friends.

items.prompt: Match each word to its root word.
hints: Take off any prefix or suffix.
What is the main word that is left?
Start with rebuild. Take off re-.
items.explanation: The root word is what is left after you take off the prefix and the suffix, like build in rebuild.

items.prompt: Write the root word of unkindness.
hints: This word has a prefix and a suffix.
Take off un- at the front.
Now take off the suffix at the end.
items.explanation: Un + kind + ness = unkindness. The root word is kind.

items.prompt: An actor is someone who acts. What is a musician?

options.why: A musician is a person.
A musician is a person, not a lesson.
A musician is a person, not a place.

hints: Look at the root word inside musician.
The ending -ian often means a person.
Think of magician: someone who does magic.
items.explanation: Musician comes from music. The ending -ian means a person, so a musician is someone who plays music.

items.prompt: Sort the words into their word families.
hints: Look for the root word inside each word.
Each word has sign, act or light inside it.
Start with lighthouse. Which root word can you see?
items.explanation: Signal, signature and signpost share sign. Action, actor and active share act. Sunlight and lighthouse share light.

items.prompt:
Use a word from the care family.
Please be ___ with the glass vase.
hints: The care family has words ending in -ful, -less and -er.
You need a word that means taking care.
Read the sentence with each care word in the gap.
items.explanation: Careful means full of care. You should be careful with a glass vase.

items.prompt: Use the word family to work out the meaning. What is childhood?

options.why: The ending -hood here does not mean a hat!

options.text: the time when you are a child

options.why: That would be a class or a group.
Childhood is a time of life, not a game.

hints: The root word is child.
The ending -hood can mean a time of life.
Think of the word babyhood.
items.explanation: Childhood means the time of your life when you are a child. The suffix -hood can mean a time or state.

items.prompt: Which word is NOT in the same family as the others?

options.why: Signal comes from sign.
Signature comes from sign: you sign your name.
A signpost is a post that holds signs.

hints: Three of the words are linked by meaning to sign.
Starting with the same letters is not enough.
Which word has nothing to do with signs or signing?
items.explanation: Single starts with si, like sign, but it means one. It has nothing to do with sign, so it is not in the family.

items.prompt:
Use two words from the act family.
The ___ was very ___ on stage, jumping and dancing.
hints: One word names a person. The other describes someone who moves a lot.
Both words start with act.
Start with the person. What do you call someone who acts in a play?
items.explanation: An actor is a person who acts. Active means moving a lot.

items.prompt: Bio means life and graph means writing. Which word means the written story of a person's life?

options.why: Biology is the study of living things.
Biscuit starts with bi, but it is a food!
In bicycle, bi means two wheels.

hints: Look for a word with bio at the start.
Then look for the part that means writing.
Which word has both parts?
items.explanation: Biography is made of bio (life) and graph (writing). It is a written story of a person's life.

items.prompt: What is the root word of unhappy?

options.why: Un is a prefix. It is not the root.
This is not a word.
This is not a word.

hints: Take off the prefix.
What is left?
The prefix is un-.
items.explanation: Take off un- and happy is left. Happy is the root word.

items.prompt: Which word is in the same word family as teach?

options.why: Reach rhymes, but it has a different meaning.
Peach is a fruit. It has nothing to do with teaching.
Beach is by the sea. It has nothing to do with teaching.

hints: A word family shares the same root.
Look for teach inside the word.
Cover the ending.
items.explanation: Teacher is teach plus -er, so it is in the same family. The others only rhyme.

items.prompt: Write the root word of careful.
hints: Cover the ending.
The ending is -ful.
What is left?
items.explanation: Careful is care plus -ful. The root word is care.

items.prompt: Sort the words into the word family each belongs to.
hints: Look for the root in each word.
Cover the prefix or suffix.
Start with replay. What is left after re-?
items.explanation: Each word is its root with a prefix or suffix added.

items.prompt: Citra loves to ___. She is a very good ___.
hints: Both words come from one root.
The first gap needs a doing word.
The second gap needs a person.
items.explanation: Dance is the doing word. A dancer is a person who dances.

items.prompt: Match each root word to a word in its family.
hints: Find the root inside each longer word.
Look at the start and the end of the word.
Start with untie. Take off the prefix.
items.explanation: Each longer word is built from its root word with a prefix or suffix.

items.prompt: Which word is NOT in the same family as the others?

options.why: Earache is ear plus ache.
Earring is ear plus ring.
Earplug is ear plus plug.

hints: Look for a root hidden in each word.
Three words share a body part.
Does the odd word mean something to do with ears?
items.explanation: Earth looks like it has ear in it, but it is not about ears.

items.prompt: Write the root word of disagreement.
hints: It has a prefix and a suffix.
Take off dis- and -ment.
Think about the last letter of the root.
items.explanation: Disagreement is dis- plus agree plus -ment. The root word is agree.

items.prompt:
Use a word from the friend family.
Their ___ has lasted since they were five.
hints: Which word fits has lasted?
You need a noun, not a describing word.
Add a suffix that makes a noun.
items.explanation: Friendship is a noun from friend. It fits the sentence.

items.prompt: Choose all the words in the help family.

options.why: Helmet looks like help, but it is a different word.
Hello looks a bit like help, but it is not related.

hints: A word family shares a root and a meaning.
Cover the ending.
Does each word have help inside it?
items.explanation: Helper, helpless and helpful all come from help. Helmet and hello are different words.

items.prompt: What does unbreakable mean?

options.why: That would be rebreakable.
That would be misbroken.
That is the opposite.

hints: Split the word into parts.
Un-, break, -able.
Un- means not and -able means can be.
items.explanation: Unbreakable is un- (not) plus break plus -able (can be). It means not able to be broken.

items.prompt: Port means carry, and ex- means out. What does export mean?

options.text: to carry goods into a country
options.why: That is import.
That would need re-.
That would need mis-.

options.text: to carry goods out of a country

hints: Use the meaning of each part.
Ex- means out.
Port means carry.
items.explanation: Ex- means out and port means carry, so export means carry out.

items.prompt: Which word is in the same family as decide?

options.why: Deceive looks similar, but means to trick.
Decimal looks similar, but is about tenths.
Decorate looks similar, but means to make pretty.

hints: A family word keeps the same meaning.
Spelling can change a little.
Think of a noun for choosing.
items.explanation: Decide and decision are in the same family. The spelling changes a little but the meaning stays.

items.prompt: Write the root word of disappearance.
hints: It starts with a prefix.
It ends with a noun suffix.
Take off dis- and -ance.
items.explanation: Disappearance is dis- plus appear plus -ance. The root is appear.

items.prompt: Geo means earth. Logy means the study of. What is geology?

options.why: That is biology. Bio means life.

options.text: the writing of a person's life
options.why: That is a biography.

options.text: the study of the Earth and its rocks

options.why: That is astronomy.

hints: Use both word parts.
Geo plus logy.
Think of earth plus study.
items.explanation: Geo (earth) plus logy (the study of) means the study of the Earth.

items.prompt: Dict means say or speak. Choose all the words that come from dict.

options.why: District has dist, not dict.
Dentist is about teeth.

hints: Look for dict inside each word.
Check the meaning is about saying.
Does the word involve speaking or words?
items.explanation: Predict, dictate and dictionary all come from dict. District and dentist do not.

items.prompt: True or false: The root word of the word unhappy is happy.
hints: Take off the prefix.
What is left after un-?
Happy is still a word.
items.explanation: The root word is the main part that carries the meaning. Un- is a prefix added to happy.

items.prompt: True or false: The root word of the word carefully is carefull.
hints: Take off the suffix -ly first.
Then take off -ful.
The root is a short word meaning to look after.
items.explanation: The root word is care. The suffixes -ful and -ly were added, and one l was dropped from -ful.

items.prompt: True or false: The words act, actor and action belong to the same word family.
hints: Look for the shared letters.
They share the root act.
Do they share a meaning?
items.explanation: Words in a family share a root and a related meaning. These words are all about doing things.

items.prompt: True or false: The words play and plane are in the same word family because they look similar.
hints: Looking alike is not enough.
Does plane come from play?
Check the meanings.
items.explanation: Words are in a family only if they share a root and a related meaning. Play and plane look alike but the meanings are not connected.
